reason: The reported 2.23 comes from an unadjusted regression, although supplier_diversity is correlated with pre-period covariates (log sales r=0.31, years exporting, prior export growth). Adding the pre-period controls cuts the estimate to about 0.61 (SE 0.23), roughly 70% smaller, so the headline magnitude is confounded. The report also gives only one specification and doesn't address this. The sign stays positive, but the reported effect size isn't supported.
